scene otohachikabath1

scene otohachikabath2
And these are Otoha Okakura’s boobs.
scene nightsky
They were good boobs. Firm.

Still growing, albeit much slower nowadays. Which was probably for the best because if they wound up the size of Haruka’s or something like that, the proportions of her body would be all weird and not look right.
They were solid B’s, though. Maybe C’s? Which would rank them as S, A, or B respectively but probably not any lower. So the equation we can work with here is like B = C = S = A = B.
This is a good equation because you can easily turn it into a fun acronym like “Boobs could save a boy.” Which is true. Just look at the protagonist of this game.
scene otohachikabath2
Now, look at Otoha’s boobs again.
scene otohachikabath1

Now, back to her face. Because if the rest of this event alternated between naught but these two stills, we’d miss out on the impending conversation between her and whoever she’s looking at right now.
scene otohachikabath2
Before that, though, let’s have a quick recap on the recent happenings in this heroine’s life.
scene otohachikabath1

Otoha Okakura, who was currently about 80%% through the process of getting over a crush on her vocal coach, had suddenly realized her relationship with said entity was becoming a bit more complicated than she thought.
scene otohachikabath2

Niki Nakayama, the friendless darling of Kumon-mi, had been leaning a little harder on Otoha lately since she was the only girl Ami’s age who was both not fucking her boyfriend and also on good terms with her.
scene otohachikabath1

This meant that 80%% was working its way back down to 75%%. And, before Otoha knew it, she’d be right back to fingering herself to pictures of the idol once she completed her first few rounds of Ami’s favorite shota sites.
scene otohachikabath2
She hadn’t had any contact with Ami ever since being propositioned for weird sex with her. Which was certainly enticing to her. But it was wrong for a number of reasons.
scene otohachikabath1

First and foremost, Ami didn’t have a penis. And while Otoha could strap one onto her like Ami suggested, she had a feeling it wouldn’t be the same. And the innocence she so craved could not possibly come from such a corrupted being.
scene otohachikabath2
Secondly, Niki would probably have a problem with it. At least given the context of everything lately and how fucking Ami would be kind of like fucking Niki’s daughter.
scene otohachikabath1
She still thought about it, though. And would likely think about it for another few weeks until something else happened to arouse her and she started thinking about that instead.
scene otohachikabath3
Perhaps it would even be with Chika. The enemies to lovers tag is doing numbers lately and the two of them are naked right now.
scene otohachikabath4
Here are Chika’s boobs for posterity. Please like and subscribe.
scene otohachikabath5
: I can’t believe the showers broke again for reasons completely unrelated to fan-service and that we have somehow found ourselves naked in the same bath.
: What? I just asked why you’ve been staring at me for the last five minutes.
: That is not even remotely close to what I heard.
: Yeah, well if you could keep your eyes off of my chest for more than three seconds at a time, you might be able to actually understand what I’m saying to you.
: Dude, you’re the one who’s been alternating between my boobs and my face since the moment you sat down.
scene otohachikabath6
: Nuh-uh. Idiot.
: You’re doing it literally right now.
: Yeah, well now I’m thinking about it and they’re literally right there. Sue me.
: I’m feeling very violated right now.
scene otohachikabath7
: GAAAAAH! Why’d it have to be you of all people?! Why couldn’t I wind up here with Noriko or Yumi or-
: Or Rin?
scene otohachikabath8

: No...That’s not what I was going to say. And you using your past-relationship with her as leverage to make me feel bad is, like, totally fucked up. Like, can you please shut up about Rin? Oh my god.
: All I did was say her name.
scene otohachikabath9

: Fine! Well, since we’re already talking about her, I guess I can just say that it would be better if she was here because she wouldn’t spend the whole night making me feel like an insignificant, whiny bitch!
: Just shut up already! Holy shit!
scene otohachikabath10
: Please fight with me. I need it or I’m going to think.
: You good, bro?
scene otohachikabath11

: No, Otoha! I’m not good! The girl I like likes the boy I like and the boy I like likes everyone! And it doesn’t help that you actually got to be with the girl I like and she got to touch your stupid perky boobs!
: Will...touching them make you feel better?
scene otohachikabath12
: No. She already fucking hates me and groping her ex would surely only make that worse.
: Well, to be fair, you did kind of bring that on yourself by suddenly cutting all ties with her. That’s not exactly a thing a person does when they want to be closer.
: It was either that or lose myself. I was going fucking crazy. I still am. You’ve seen me.
: More of you than I ever expected to, yeah.
scene otohachikabath13
: How did you do it? If...you don’t mind me asking.
: What? Like, break up?
: No, like...not fall completely and crazily in love with her? How did you just end it and be totally okay and not want to jump off a bridge afterward?
: You really like her that much? To the point where you want to jump off a bridge?
: Please don’t ask me questions that direct when I’m in the middle of trying to convince myself that I don’t feel the things I feel.
scene otohachikabath14
: Hah...You two really would make a good couple. Just, you’re both so blind with adoration that I worry you’d never be able to take your eyes off of each other.
: She’s so fucking cute that I want to strangle her. But she hasn’t looked at me the way I look at her in a very long time because it’s all Sensei now.
: Ahh, yes. Sensei. The other person you would have killed for until recently. Who still probably doesn’t know about your feelings for Rin.
scene otohachikabath15
: I would still kill for him! I love them both! But he definitely can not know about this because he wouldn’t take me cheating on him half as well as I took him cheating on me!
: Correct me if I’m wrong here, but I heard you almost threw Yumi off your balcony.
: Yeah, so just imagine what he would do! Yumi would be a fucking puddle right now!
: So you cheat on him with Rin and Yumi winds up dying for it? Can’t say I’m the biggest fan of that girl. But even then, that seems a little unfair to me.
: Just answer my question and tell me how I’m supposed to move on from her! I can’t afford to stay so invested in  a relationship that isn’t ever going to go anywhere!
: Then why’d you choose Sensei?
scene otohachikabath16
: Well...I...
: Did you think Rin would turn you down? Were you afraid of the rejection or something?
: How could I not be? The last thing you want to hear when you feel that way about someone is that they don’t feel the same.
: Rin was terrified when she confessed to you, Chika. But she did it anyway because she felt like it was worth the risk.

: Now, here you are stuck in a “relationship” with a man that’s openly dating your idol without a clue in the world of what to do. So much so that you’d come to me for advice despite years worth of coldness and insults.

: What do you want me to say, Otoha? That I’m a selfish idiot who’s afraid of change and terrified that one wrong move could cause my whole life to go up in flames? Because, there. I just said it. Now heal me.
scene otohachikabath17
: I can’t heal you. Hell, I can’t even offer you any advice on what I would have done in your situation because I’d never date Akira in the first place. This is all on you, dude.

: I didn’t know what I was doing! He was so cool and hot and...and he kept coming to see me. And, like...my sister liked him. He paid for our phones. It was all so fucking good and stable until it just...wasn’t.
: Yet you’re still clinging to him. So that toxic positivity is still here even now that you’re aware your life is crashing and burning.
: But at least now that I know what I’m in for, I can try to extinguish the blaze instead of just throwing myself into a new fire. One who smells like coffee and changes her hair every season.
: I can’t tell you how to get over her, Chika. Not when you’re clearly more into her than I ever was.
scene otohachikabath18
: Which, before you get mad at me, I definitely was into her. And while I may have said I love her, that was really just a lie I told myself to excuse the fact that I also cheated on her.
scene otohachikabath19
: You what?! With who?! I’ve never heard about this! Does Rin know about this?!
: Nope. And the only reason I’m telling you it even happened in the first place is because I know you’ll be afraid of me blowing your secret to Akira in return.
: Was it...it’s not with Sensei, right? So...Nodoka? Noriko? Who?
: Some older girl. One around Akira’s age but a little younger.
scene otohachikabath20
: What?
: It was just once. And it was, like...not even cheating on her end. I kind of just threw myself at her and hoped she’d like me back, but...nope.
scene otohachikabath21
: Not like nothing good came of it, though. Because that’s when I really knew how I felt about Rin. I just had to deal with a little bit of denial and shame before ever accepting it.
: It was...
scene otohachikabath22

: It was kind of the same for me. I didn’t realize how big my feelings were until they were already out of control and I was...doing things I don’t regret, but...things I’m still ashamed of regardless.
: It’s okay to fuck up, you know.
scene otohachikabath23
: It...is?

: At least when it comes to this stuff. Romance is, like...the one thing in my life I’m not afraid to fail at. I feel like you kind of need to at this age. To figure out what you want. Like, it worked for us, right?
: Sure, but at what cost?
: Who cares? If the cost is too great and you wind up hurting over it, just figure out what you need to do to make things good again.
: It’s adversity and hardship that turn us into amazing people. Look at Beethoven. One of the greatest musicians to ever live. Deaf. Depressed. Suicidal. But he gave us Moonlight Sonata.
: Without heroin, Charlie Parker never writes Relaxin’ at Camarillo. Without schizoaffective disorder, Brian Wilson never releases Pet Sounds.
: Suffering strengthens us. You just...you know, need to deal with the fact that it might kill you too. But hey, trade-offs like that are taken by nine out of ten artists for a reason.
scene otohachikabath24
: I’m not an artist, though...I don’t have anything to give to the world. The only name I even recognized there was Beethoven.
: Now, how am I supposed to have faith in a manager who doesn’t see what we’re doing in the light music club as art?
scene otohachikabath25
: You’re a part of that too, dude. Don’t write yourself off just because you aren’t playing an instrument. How do you think Niki would feel about that?
: I...that...
scene otohachikabath26
: Hey, wait a minute. How do you know her? Because you two seemed kind of familiar with each other on Christmalloween.
: Through Noriko maybe? Or is this another situation like it was with Sensei where I should have already known but have just been unintentionally ignoring it for a long time?
: I think a better question is how you’re still standing after she spoke to you directly.
: Walking does feel harder now. That’s not important, though. What are you hiding?
: I’ll tell you the next time the shower breaks. I don’t think you’re ready yet.
: Otoha...

: If I find out that the cool older girl you cheated on Rin with is Niki...I swear to god...everything I said tonight will be invalidated and your roommate will wake up bathed in your blood. Do you understand?
: Elizabeth Bathory used to do that for fun. I think Nodoka might like it as well.
: Otoha. Do not smile at me, you incorrigible bitch. Are you an agent from Hell sent here to corrupt every person I have ever laid my eyes on?
: Not all of them. I haven’t touched Akira yet. And at this rate, I feel like I’m probably going to be the last person in our class to actually do that.
: This implies that it will happen eventually, though.
: We’d be kidding ourselves if we said it won’t. This world is cursed and I exist within it to make more mistakes.
: I can’t believe I almost started liking you for a second.
: It’s the boobs.
scene otohachikabath27
: It’s like they’re toeing the line between cute and hot. The golden ratio of chests.
: Yes. Stare deeper into them and forget everything you know about Niki and me.
scene otohachikabath28
: So you’re friends with Io too? How did that happen? I’ve never seen her talk to anyone but Uta and Miku.
: I wouldn’t say we’re friends. But we were in a few classes together at Kumon-mi Academy before the whole sinkhole thing happened and she doesn’t seem to hate me.
: Was your hair ever shorter? Maybe she thought you were a boy.
: You know, I feel like a lot of people wished I was.
: Sounds rough. I only got popular because I’m hot and mixed.
: I was just talented. And also hot, I guess. Nobody really seems to care at our current school, though.
: They’re all just background characters anyway. No one really matters outside of 1-A. That’s why they gave us our own dorm.
: Is that not just because you’re all too loud and obnoxious for the other one?
: No, it’s because we’re special. Stupid bitch. Listen when your manager is speaking to you.
: Apologies, madame. I didn’t realize I was talking to-
: Wha-
scene otohachikabath29
: R-Rin?! H...Heeeey!
: Uhhh...wh...what are you.......umm...
: Well, this definitely won’t negatively affect her at all.
: What...are you two doing together?...
: We’re not! Or...we weren’t!
: Aren’t you supposed to be enemies?...
: Now you’re hanging out and bathing together when you’ll barely even speak to me?...
: Wait! This is-
: We used to do that together...
: Rin, listen!
: What did I do to make you hate me this much?...
scene otohachikabath30
: I...It’s not like that! We just bumped into each other and...I...well...Otoha can tell you! Right, Otoha?!
scene otohachikabath31
: It’s true. She wouldn’t shut up about you the whole time. I almost drowned her.
: You could have left that part out, asshole! All you had to say was “yes!”
: Oh, my bad. Yes.
: Oh, fuck you!
: Come on, Futaba...Chika needs her fucking space.
scene otohachikabath32
: Rin, wait! I’m sorry! I seriously don’t even like Otoha!
scene otohachikabath33
: Don’t be mad at me! Please! I miss you! I-
: Chika...not right now. Sorry. Just...go back to leaving her alone for the night, okay?
: Futaba! We were just leaving! That’s it!
scene otohachikabath34
: Wait, who the fuck is that?
